item.description: EgglestonWorks Andra 5 loudspeaker John Atkinson Thu, 01/29/2026 - 06:02 Show Promo Image Big loudspeakers are where diligent hi-fi reviewers really earn their pay. Not only are they heavy and difficult to move, but they also require attention and patience to set up so that they sound their best in our listening spaces. They take time to understand and study. And they all sound quite different from each other. Tom Fine 0 0 EgglestonWorks 540 Cumberland St. Memphis TN 38112 answers@egglestonworks
